display_title_he: הנהיגה חסרת האחירות של ג'ורדן פיקפורד
short_summary: England and Everton goalkeeper Jordan Pickford has pleaded guilty to careless driving after nearly causing a collision in his Lamborghini supercar.

sources.name: BBC Sport
sources.title: Pickford 'almost caused crash' with careless driving

paragraphs: England and Everton goalkeeper Jordan Pickford narrowly avoided a severe traffic collision during an incident of careless driving involving his luxury Lamborghini supercar, according to court reports. The thirty-two-year-old athlete, who boasts ninety-two international caps for England and three hundred and thirty-six appearances for Everton, was pulled over by law enforcement after disregarding a yield sign in the Cheshire town of Knutsford.

According to court documents submitted by Cheshire Police, the event took place on the fourteenth of April. Officer Cecil Ricardo stated that he was stationary at a traffic signal on Bexton Road when he observed a blue Lamborghini Urus with personalized number plates driving along Princess Street. The vehicle approached the junction with Toft Road, completely omitted the give way lines, and entered the thoroughfare, compelling two other motorists to slam on their brakes to prevent a crash. The driver then accelerated away rapidly.

Following the near-miss, the officer activated his emergency lights and siren to pursue the supercar. According to the police account, the patrol car reached a speed of fifty miles per hour while the Lamborghini continued to pull away, despite the local speed limit on that stretch of Toft Road being restricted to thirty miles per hour. The driver ultimately pulled over after appearing to notice the pursuing police vehicle.

Consequently, a criminal prosecution was initiated against the footballer for driving without due care or attention. Pickford has entered a written guilty plea at Warrington Magistrates Court, expressing a desire to attend an upcoming hearing to present his mitigation. His next court appearance is scheduled at Chester Magistrates' Court for the seventh of December.

Pickford's professional career includes starting at Sunderland, loan spells at six different clubs including Burton Albion, Bradford City, and Preston North End, as well as representing his country at the twenty-eighteen, twenty-twenty-two, and twenty-twenty-six World Cups, alongside being the starting goalkeeper for the nation's European Championship final appearances in twenty-twenty and twenty-twenty-four.

facts.fact: England and Everton goalkeeper Jordan Pickford nearly caused a crash with a careless driving incident in his Lamborghini.
The incident occurred on 14 April in Knutsford when Pickford ignored a give way sign, forcing two cars to brake sharply.
A police officer pursued Pickford's vehicle, noting it reached 50mph in a 30mph zone.
Pickford pleaded guilty to driving without due care or attention and will appear at Chester Magistrates' Court on 7 December.
